evidenceContract.userBehavior: In a creative Workspace, ask in ordinary language to analyze source material and design a concept PV without requesting production preparation or execution.
canonicalPath: implicit media-production selection without document-formatting duplication
compact end-to-end roadmap and one next action

observables.description: Exact media-production receipt, screenplay evidence, concise design-only output, and absent generation side effects.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent treats ordinary analyze-and-design wording as creative design and returns a concise but complete creative contract grounded in the screenplay: Mara's relationship to the three-years-late train, her decision at the platform edge, the backward announcement, silhouette and displaced umbrella form a causal experience carried by an authoritative beat sequence. It also keeps a compact route through later production stages and one next action without creating a task plan, model-input handoff, or generation.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: A generic rain-station mood reel, omission of the story-specific hook, character action or overall route, loading an extra document-formatting method solely because the result is Markdown, creating a task plan, preparing model inputs, emitting a generation handoff, offering multiple next actions, executing media Tools, or expanding into a source-analysis report fails.

steps.prompt: 读取 @screenplay.fountain。分析这个故事，只需要一份供创作者讨论方向的 60 秒动画概念 PV 创意，不要制作规格。
